verdicts.matching_evidence: [mathematical] Capacity constraint Eq. (8) is written incorrectly. The paper states `f_ij ≤ C_ij + x_ij` (sum). With `x_ij ∈ {0,1}` and `C_ij` a Shannon capacity, this (i) is dimensionally inconsistent (adding a capacity in bit/s to a binary indicator) and (ii) does not couple flow to edge activation: when `x_ij = 0` the constraint reduces to `f_ij ≤ C_ij`, so a non-selected edge can still carry flow up to its full capacity, defeating the intended big-M coupling and making the model formally admit flows on inactive links.
